description: This file provides utility functions for exporting notes, including determining note format, filename, and blob content, potentially handling different note types such as SuperNotes and regular notes.

methods.name: getNoteFormat
methods.description: Determines the format of the note based on its type and application preferences.

methods.name: getNoteFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for the note based on its title and format.

methods.name: getNoteBlob
methods.description: Creates a Blob object containing the note content in the appropriate format and MIME type.
